read.en: Corning fell 12.9% on Nov 5 to $103.43, trading $101.83–114.20 on 2.2 times its 20-day average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($118.97), 10-day ($123.27), 30-day ($140.34) and 100-day ($158.78) and the rising 200-day ($156.14). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($129.85), and RSI is 27, oversold.
read.zh: 康宁 11月5日下跌 12.9%，收于 $103.43，盘中区间 $101.83–114.20，成交量为 20 日均量的 2.2 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$118.97）、10 日（$123.27）、30 日（$140.34）和 100 日均线（$158.78）以及上行的 200 日均线（$156.14）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$129.85），RSI 为 27，处于超卖区。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $114.5–115.4 and $110 supports, now resistance, and the close is the lowest since Jan 30. Resistance is $110, then $114.2–115.4 (Nov 5 high, Jul 28 and Nov 4 lows) and $119–120.5 (5-day, Oct 30 low). Support is $99.5–101.8 (Jan 29 low, Nov 5 low, $100), then $91–95.7 (Jan 20–23 lows, Jan 22 high). A close above $110 would target $114–115; below $99.5, $91–96.

r.en: Nov 5 high $114.2; Jul 28 low $114.5; Nov 4 low $115.4
